name: Simple Tank
axis_orientation: Rear-to-front, with the muzzle at the front (+1) and the engine deck at the rear (-1)
operating_principle: The main battle tank operates by using its powerful engine and transmission to propel the vehicle, while the turret and gun system provide firepower and maneuverability. The tank's armor and running gear work together to protect the crew and maintain mobility in various environments.

components.description: The main structural body of the tank, housing the engine, crew, and ammunition.
The rotating structure that houses the gun and turret crew.
The main armament of the tank, capable of firing anti-armor and anti-personnel rounds.
The system of wheels, tracks, and suspension that allows the tank to move.
The combination of the engine and transmission that powers the tank.
The system that stabilizes and aims the gun, allowing for accurate firing on the move.
The protective plating that covers the tank, including composite armor and reactive armor.
The raised structure that provides the commander with a view of the surroundings.
